confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Koh Samui tourist pricing for July 2026; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately well grounded; accommodation anchors are less certain because they vary by beach area and booking lead time. July is treated as a regular, not off-season, month, and accommodation anchors assume typical taxes and service charges are included. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (roughly two to two-and-a-half times beer) because direct knowledge of island bar and wine prices is weaker. The FX observation comes from search-result snippets citing the RBA exchange-rates page; the live table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Thai island and beach-resort destinations with similar tourist pricing, such as Phuket and Krabi, adjusted using general knowledge of Koh Samui's tourist areas. No single named comparable city was used.
